page.overview:
Who is Terry Gong?

Terry Gong is a character that appears in Cars 2.

Just as McQueen and his team go inside the Tokyo National Art Center, Terry can be seen banging a large gong, creating a loud noise.

Although he doesn't appear in Mater's flashback during his embarrassment, but before Mater's flashback ends and ends up in London alongside Finn McMissile & Holley Shiftwell, Mater can be seen taking Terry Gong's roll, banging the gong and saying "Bang the gong, get it on".
